identity_definition: exact matched residues / nongap paired columns
coverage_definition: nongap paired columns / each full reference sequence length
extra_positive_links: exact sequence containment, shorter length >=40 aa
length_ratio_skip: minimum_length / maximum_length <0.8 proves impossible for paired-column both coverage
composition_skip: sum min amino acid counts <0.24*max length proves impossible

scoring.alignment_selection: first optimal alignment returned by frozen Bio version

claim_boundary: declared full-reference similarity and exact domain containment; not a certified universal protein-family holdout
